item.title: Graph neural network prediction of temperature-dependent hydrogen diffusion and thermal conductivity tensors of tungsten containing helium bubbles and grain boundaries
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 S. Saito, M. I. Kobayashi, T. Kasahara
arXiv:2608.15609v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Helium bubbles and grain boundaries in tungsten plasma-facing components alter hydrogen-isotope transport and thermal conduction by orders of magnitude, yet evaluating these transport properties for a given microstructure requires hours of molecular dynamics (MD) per configuration. We present a graph neural network surrogate that maps a tungsten atomic configuration containing helium bubbles and grain boundaries directly to the full 3×3 symmetric tensors of the hydrogen diffusion coefficient D_H(T) and the thermal conductivity κ(T) at arbitrary temperature. item.title: 原子尺度机器学习中的长程静电作用：物理视角
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Federico Grasselli, Kevin Rossi, Stefano de Gironcoli, Andrea Grisafi
这篇综述从物理角度讨论如何在原子尺度机器学习模型中纳入长程静电作用，同时保持可迁移表示所依赖的局域性原则。作者区分了局域电荷模型、自洽或非局域描述符引入的非局域模型，以及通过极化耦合纳入有限电场效应的方法。文章还讨论了这些思想对电化学界面模拟和离子输运现象建模的影响。

item.title: 用于带电点缺陷的多保真机器学习原子间势
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Xinwei Wang, Irea Mosquera-Lois, Aron Walsh
该工作指出，现有基础机器学习原子间势难以准确描述半导体 Sb₂Se₃ 的缺陷物理，尤其是在配位环境和电子数偏离理想晶体时。作者引入全局缺陷电荷嵌入以区分不同电荷态的成键特征，并采用多保真策略结合低成本半局域数据与高质量杂化泛函能量和力。所得力场能够以远低于直接量子力学计算的成本预测稳定缺陷结构和缺陷热力学，并与量子力学结果定量一致。

item.title: Phonon-Mediated Thermal Transport in Nanocrystalline Silicon Using Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Houssem Rezgui, Catalina Coll Benejam, Clivia M. Sotomayor Torres, Miguel Pruneda
arXiv:2607.06470v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Understanding phonon-mediated heat transport in structurally complex materials remains a central challenge for next-generation electronic and nanomechanical devices, where grain boundaries and interfacial disorder strongly limit thermal dissipation. Although classical interatomic potentials enable large-scale simulations, their limited transferability can lead to inaccuracies in vibrational properties and interfacial phonon scattering. In this work, we develop a machine learning-based framework for modeling thermal transport in bulk and nanocrystalline silicon by combining Gaussian approximation potential and multi-atomic cluster expansion models with lattice-dynamical calculations and molecular dynamics. Harmonic and anharmonic force co…

item.title: 通过专家混合与参数高效微调实现用于量能器的可泛化基础模型
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Carlos Cardona-Giraldo, Cristiano Fanelli, James Giroux, Cole Granger, Benjamin Nachman and Gerald Sabin
该工作提出一种面向量能器模拟的可泛化基础模型，基于 next-token Transformer 骨干，并结合专家混合预训练与参数高效微调。模型可跨吸收材料、粒子种类和探测器配置进行模块化适配，同时降低灾难性遗忘风险。结果表明，next-token 架构可作为构建可扩展、具备物理感知能力的量能器基础模型的可行路径。

The Co-VAE approach integrates an auxiliary fuel property prediction regression head with the VAE latent space, enhancing molecular reconstruction and accurate property estimation (Research Octane Number (RON) chosen as the fuel property of interest for demonstration studies). A subset of the GDB-13 database, combined with a curated RON database, is used for the Co-VAE training. item.title: 从从头算分子动力学轨迹高数据效率构建材料特异性机器学习原子间势
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jonas Hänseroth, Christian Dreßler
预训练机器学习原子间势为原子模拟提供了有吸引力的起点，但若无额外参考数据，其材料特异性精度常受限制。本文系统比较五种通用 MLIP 框架在七类化学多样体系中的微调与从头训练表现，发现 10 个 AIMD 构型通常不足，200 个在有利情况下可行，而 2000 个构型是更稳健的默认选择。研究还指出，同样数据下从头训练常可与朴素微调竞争，且应在目标可观测量层面验证模型。

item.title: 通过机器学习-符号回归发现用于预测金属有机框架中 CO2 吸附的物理可解释数学表达式
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yimin Shao, Shengluo Ma, Shenghong Ju, Yijun Shi, Wei Li
本文提出一种机器学习-符号回归策略，用于构建预测假想金属有机框架低压 CO2 吸附容量的物理可解释公式。作者在小样本数据集上训练模型并通过 SHAP 与特征重要性分析识别五个关键描述符，再用符号回归得到简洁吸附公式。该公式在大规模 hMOF 数据集验证中对 62,448 个结构达到超过 70% 的预测准确率，并提供了比黑箱模型更清晰的机理解释。

item.title: Machine Learning-Accelerated Band-Edge Engineering of Pnictogen Chalcohalide Solid Solutions for Solar Energy Technologies
item.description:

arXiv:2608.16611v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pnictogen chalcohalide (MChX; M=Bi,Sb; Ch=S,Se; X=I,Br) solid solutions combine earth-abundant constituents, tunable band gaps (1.2-2.1 eV), and strong optical absorption, making them attractive for solar energy conversion. Building on the EQL architecture, eight operators are introduced to replace standard activation functions to fit the mathematical equations in nanocrystal synthesis. item.title: Benchmarking Quantum Machine Learning for Power-System Attack Detection: Evaluation Choices Decide the Outcome Before the Models Do
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Md Rezwanul Islam
arXiv:2608.15617v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning detectors for power-system cyberattacks are themselves attack surfaces, and quantum machine learning has been proposed for them. We benchmark fidelity-kernel SVMs and variational classifiers against six tuned classical models on public power-system attack data (Mississippi State/ORNL), across white-box, transfer, decision-based black-box, and poisoning attacks. Our headline finding is methodological: the benchmark's answers are set by the evaluator's choices before the models. Eight choices -- six in the evaluation protocol, two in the tuning the benchmark itself runs -- each reversed or moved a conclusion at fixed models. arXiv:2605.29683v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a comprehensive benchmarking dataset and empirical scaling law analysis for neural network wavefunctions by matching them to a wide spectrum of famous many body target wavefunctions. By using wavefunction fidelity as the uniform metric, we discover empirical scaling…

arXiv:2608.16329v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bulk materials, as opposed to nanomaterials, require molecular dynamics (MD) simulations on a large spatial scale (~10⁹ atoms or more) to adequately capture their atomic-scale physical properties. item.title: 面向海上环境的机器学习表层参数化方案开发
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Susan Dettling, Sue Ellen Haupt, Thomas Brummet, Patrick Hawbecker, Branko Kosović, David John Gagne
本文测试机器学习方法在海上环境中拟合表面与大气之间湍流通量关系的可行性。研究使用了三个海上观测点的数据：MVCO空气-海洋相互作用塔、FINO1研究平台以及部署在美国加州外海的CASPER-West FLIP研究船。结果表明，在部分站点，基于神经网络或随机森林建立的模型可与专门面向海上通量的物理模型COARE-3相当，甚至更优。

👤 Begoña Ispizua, Serio Gil-López, Leire Arrizabalaga, Ibai Laña
arXiv:2608.14764v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: With the increasing integration of renewable energy sources, energy storage systems have become essential, making the accurate estimation of their State of Health (SOH) and degradation behavior critical. In this work, we propose a physics-informed deep learning approach for lithium-ion battery SOH prediction using incomplete discharge curves extracted from arbitrary voltage ranges, thereby reflecting realistic and heterogeneous operating conditions. The proposed method combines data-driven learning with physically motivated degradation dynamics to ensure consistent and reliable SOH estimation from partial discharge information, achieving a MAPE below 4%. item.description:

arXiv:2505.19036v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a mesh-free approach to solving high-dimensional PDEs on complex geometries, but their theoretical foundations on manifolds remain limited. Moreover, conventional PINN analyses typically rely on solution smoothness, while PINNs may perform poorly for low-regularity solutions arising from nonlinear hyperbolic equations. In this paper, we develop a weak PINN (wPINN) framework for approximating entropy solutions of geometry-compatible hyperbolic conservation laws on Riemannian manifolds M^d. item.title: 交替磁 CoF₂ 中的反铁四极有序
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Daniel Halliday, Laura Pöysti, Chung Xu, Daniel A. Mayoh, Didier Wermeille, Dharmalingam Prabhakaran, David R. Bowler, Roger D. Johnson
交替磁体具有非相对论自旋劈裂电子态，其微观起源理论上与隐藏电荷有序相关，但实验研究有限。本文结合共振弹性 X 射线散射、对称性分析和从头算计算，在 d 波交替磁化合物 CoF₂ 中直接观测并识别出反铁四极电荷有序。电子结构计算表明该有序导致典型交替磁自旋劈裂，证明 CoF₂ 中交替磁性的微观起源是反铁四极有序。

item.title: 六角铁氧体钡薄膜作为近邻工程自旋电子学的可扩展磁性绝缘体平台
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Shyam Sundar Poriah, Sanjana D. S., Agrim Sharma, Sreelakshmi M. Nair, Pankaj Bhardwaj, Laxmipriya Nanda, Aryaman Das, Jagadish Rajendran, R. S. Patel, Manish Jain, Dhavala Suri
本文提出溅射生长的六角铁氧体钡 BaFe12O19 薄膜可作为具有强本征垂直各向异性的磁性绝缘体替代平台，无需应变工程。结构表征和第一性原理计算证实了薄膜质量及稳健的亚铁磁基态，磁性测量显示其具有方形面外磁滞回线。与 Pt 和 BiSbTeSe2 构成界面后，BaM 诱导近邻异常霍尔输运，表明其适用于自旋电子和拓扑异质结构器件。

item.title: Chiral Damping-Induced Chirality Switching and Control of Domain Walls in Antiferromagnets
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Collins Ashu Akosa, Mu-Kun Lee, Aurélien Manchon, Masahito Mochizuki
arXiv:2608.16057v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the impact of chiral damping (CD) on current-driven domain-wall (DW) dynamics in antiferromagnets (AFMs). Asymmetric CD between sublattices generates off-diagonal components in the DW mass tensor, thereby coupling translational and rotational modes. When CD is modulated by an ac gate voltage via the Rashba spin-orbit interaction (RSOI), symmetric and asymmetric contributions induce oscillations in the DW velocity and tilt angle, respectively. A perturbative analysis yields explicit expressions for the oscillation amplitudes, in quantitative agreement with numerical simulations. item.description:

👤 Haoran Sun, Erhai Zhao, Youjin Deng, W. Vincent Liu

item.description:
